title: One-sentence explanation
message: Grounded Action Map helps people move from concern to responsible action by connecting verified humanitarian reporting, trust evidence, learning pathways, peacebuilding lenses, and future capacity.
suggestedUse: Open a meeting, video, post, or workshop.

title: Gaza: What Needs Attention Now
message: A sourced dashboard for current humanitarian priorities, review status, and responsible action pathways.
suggestedUse: Workshop slide or social card with caveats.

title: There is always a responsible pathway
message: No one has to remain stuck in helplessness. Action should move through evidence, safeguards, and review.

title: No claim without a source
message: Every public claim should carry source evidence or remain draft.

title: We do not rank organizations; we show evidence
message: Trust evidence supports responsible decision-making without scores, seals, or permanent approval.

title: Learn what is needed now
message: Learning pathways connect urgent needs to competencies, simulations, and responsible action artifacts.

title: From today to 25 years
message: Urgent action can connect to long-term recovery, dignity, wellbeing, and future peace capacity.

title: Same reality, multiple lenses
message: The Peacebuilding Lens helps users understand trauma, narrative, systems, reconciliation, and civic repair.

title: Scenarios are not predictions
message: Scenarios show assumptions, uncertainty, caveats, and what would change the analysis.

title: Capacity needs are hypotheses, not judgments
message: Capacity hypotheses require human review, local validation, and humility.

title: The present is urgent; it is also part of a longer human arc
message: Deep time is a reflective lens for responsibility across generations, not forecasting.
